scope_caveat: Local optimum over the explicitly tested candidate pool only; not a mathematical or global proof of optimality.

authority.note: PASS covers only the 7 complete configurations in the pool (raw baseline, registry canonical export, preferred five, four-swap keeping Oppression, Pass C's Megrim-over-Sedraxis five-swap, the Bloodchief Ascension six-swap alternative and the Painful Quandary seven-swap) plus named single-card contenders. They were judged with finite current-Oracle rules cases, Commander Spellbook combo lookups and a quantity-counted mana comparison. Tests run locally and in .github/workflows/m7-crosis-the-purger.yml; run URLs are recorded in the PR body. There is no statistical multiplayer ranking. The A/B seals and the owner-equivalent Pass C (final disposition NEEDS TESTING, KEEP-LOCKED pending evidence) are historical, baseline-scoped and not technically independent. Nothing here implies owner approval, M6 certification, M7 approval or a canonical change.
